MVP notice · Updated 14 November 2026. Read the current operating scope.

MVP terms

Watchpost is provided as a B2B software MVP. No customer contract, subscription, regulated service, legal entity or operational guarantee is established by viewing the site or using the demo.

Sample data, pricing and calculations

Organization names, people, places in operational records, scores, volumes, example outcomes and prices are illustrative. They are not testimonials, actual customer traction, validated forecasts or measured product performance. Arithmetic calculators disclose their assumptions.

No professional decision service

The demonstration does not replace qualified agronomy, engineering, legal, surveying, property, information security or emergency-response advice. It does not dispatch responders, control equipment, verify identity, certify vendors or confirm legal title.

Availability and data loss

The browser-local demo is supplied as-is for evaluation. Browser storage may be cleared or unavailable. Do not rely on it as a system of record or use confidential or personal operational information.

Photography credits

Industry photographs are included under their recorded licenses. They show operating context and do not represent customer sites or company assets. Sources, authors, modifications and licenses are listed below.

Fonts and brand artwork

Fonts are locally hosted Google Fonts families (Space Grotesk and DM Sans), distributed under their accompanying open font licenses. The Watchpost SVG mark and wordmark treatment were created for this product. This product does not assert trademark clearance or affiliation with an existing business.

Before commercial use

Review brand availability, replace fixture data with authorized records, implement production identity and data services, validate claims and prices, and adopt legal terms suited to the actual business and jurisdiction.

Photography and attribution

Licensed photographs show the industry context. They are not customer endorsements, staff portraits or evidence of a live camera connection.
